narration.full_text: Welcome to our lesson on trigonometry! Today, we'll cover some essential concepts that will form the foundation for your understanding of this crucial mathematical topic. First, we'll define the six fundamental trigonometric ratios, such as sine, cosine, and tangent, specifically for right-angled triangles. You'll learn how these ratios relate the angles and sides of a triangle. Next, we'll move on to applying these ratios. We'll work through various problems, showing you how to use trigonometry to find unknown side lengths or angles, and even how to verify trigonometric identities. Finally, we'll explore reciprocal trigonometric identities, understanding how they connect the primary ratios. By the end of this session, you'll have a solid grasp of these core trigonometric principles.
